<solution task="t0-even-odd">
goyu even <- 0.
goyu odd <- 0.
goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu n <- druwol(line).
    dre n trumguwu 2 == 0 ethur
        even <- even + 1.
    truthor
        odd <- odd + 1.
    wodrotru dre
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
suwe "even " & even.
suwe "odd " & odd.
</solution>

wego i <- 1 setru n

trer i
suwe result.
</solution>
